description: The dependency policy for every rapture-sh repository.

A new release waits seven days before Renovate offers it, because a compromised package is usually found and pulled within that window and nothing here is urgent enough to be the first installer of anything.
A dependency with a published advisory skips that wait: vulnerabilityAlerts sets minimumReleaseAge to null, which is its default, written down so the next reader knows it is deliberate.
Dependabot is enabled on these repositories for alerts and security fixes only, with no dependabot.yml, so one bump never produces two pull requests.
Commits are fix: because these repositories accept only feat: and fix:.
